entries.wording: Matkahuolto is waiting for the consignment from the sender
entries.note: The sender's data has arrived and the parcel has not. The tracker goes on to say it usually arrives within a couple of days; the map reads the opening words.
At a terminal, the first one included, which is where the parcel is first scanned.

entries.wording: The consignment is ready to continue its journey from Matkahuolto
entries.note: Followed by the terminal's town; the map reads the opening words.

entries.wording: The consignment is on its way
Your parcel has been sorted and will be taken next to the pickup point.
We will deliver the consignment to the pickup point during the day
entries.note: The run to the pickup point that day. The shared rules read the rest of the sentence, about the notice to come, as a parcel ready for pickup; the map reads the opening words.

entries.wording: Your pick up point has changed
entries.note: Followed by the reason, in Finnish, and the new point; the parcel goes on to that point.

entries.wording: The shipment is available for pickup with the pickup code at the pick up point
entries.note: Followed by the point's name and the last day for pickup. The scan's place names the point and its street, which become the pickup point; the code itself is not shown.

entries.wording: Your parcel is available for pick up at the pick up point
entries.note: Followed by the point's name and the last day for pickup.

entries.wording: We have sent the recipient a message about the arrival of the consignment (sms).
entries.note: A message to the recipient, not a movement: it has no stage of its own and the parcel keeps the one it had.

entries.wording: We have sent the recipient a message about the arrival of the consignment (e-mail).
entries.note: A message to the recipient, not a movement.

entries.wording: We have sent the recipient a message about the arrival of the consignment (Paketit mobile app notification).
entries.note: A message to the recipient, not a movement.

entries.wording: The recipients phone number is missing or incorrect, so we were unable to send the arrival notification via SMS. The arrival notification has been sent via email if an email address is provided in the shipment information. Phone numbers can be corrected upon the senders request; please contact the sender in this case.
entries.note: About the arrival notice, not the parcel, which keeps waiting at its point.

entries.wording: The consignment has been delivered. Thank you for choosing Matkahuolto!
entries.note: Seen on parcels collected from a pickup point or a locker.
